title: Quarter switching bound for formulas
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Suppose there is a positive integer $w$ such that $f$ has a disjunctive normal form or a conjunctive normal form whose terms or clauses each have width at most $w$. For every natural number $d$, the probability under the random restriction that leaves each coordinate free with probability $1/(20w)$ that the restricted function has decision-tree depth at least $d$ is at most $(1/4)^d$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ has a DNF or CNF of width at most $w$
